user.job: build a personal knowledge-compounding tool (ZKC) that turns dual-track information into compounding value under scarce time and attention

baseline.workflow: today uses OneNote / Obsidian / llm-wiki / gbrain / OKF separately; knowledge is captured but not transformed into compounding value, and dynamic survival-type information decays unhandled

targetOutcome: identify which OSS capabilities can be reused versus must be built, reducing ZKC build cost
goals: map the 22 research topics to OSS coverage
decide reuse vs build for each subsystem
shortlist 1-2 candidates for a hands-on spike
nonGoals: do not select a single OSS to adopt wholesale
do not implement ZKC in this step

constraints.statement: personal data; privacy and offline operation preferred
only the five given repositories plus their obvious peers

assumptions: stars and topicMatch are discovery signals, not capability scores
decisionScope: open-source capability selection for the ZKC architecture

options.name: build the dual-track + attention layer in-house
